name: Cipher
author: Erin Carter
description: Falling code rain — columns of flickering glyph cells streaming downward, each drop a bright leading character with a long fading trail, the symbols re-rolling as they fall. Classic terminal cascade in the palette's hue.

params.label: Columns
params.effect: How many glyph columns fill the frame; low is chunky, high a dense terminal.

params.label: Fall speed
params.effect: How fast the rain falls; 0 freezes it. Each column varies around this.

params.label: Trail
params.effect: Length of the fading trail behind each leading glyph; low is short sparks, high long streamers.

params.label: Flicker
params.effect: How fast the glyph symbols re-roll; 0 freezes the characters, high is a busy scramble.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer brightens columns near it; 0 ignores the mouse.
